about.heading: About
about.pageTitle: Frontend developer obsessed with AI and UI
about.designCodeBody: I mix solid design principles with practical, efficient development to create clean, responsive, and pixel-perfect interfaces. I take care of the whole process — from early research to prototypes to bringing everything to life with smooth, modern code.
about.softBody: Autonomous work, active listening, attention to detail, clear communication, collaborative mindset, adaptability
about.funfactBody: Before moving into tech I worked as a medical doctor from 2011 to 2021 in emergency departments across Argentina, after graduating from the Universidad Nacional de Córdoba — one of the country's leading universities. That experience shaped my analytical mindset and problem-solving approach in design and development.
